Driven by the `typecheck:contract-tests` npm script in package.json — run via `pnpm --filter @zn-ai/zn-agent-core typecheck:contract-tests` (also invoked as a pre-commit step in CI). The server module (`src/opencc-src/server/*`) is SELF-CONTAINED — it does not import from `compat/runtime/events.ts` or `compat/transcript/types.ts` anymore, so those compat modules are not in this include list. The `bun:bundle` and `src/*` path mappings are kept here only because the test file imports from `@zn-ai/zn-agent-core/opencc-server` and the package's underlying tsconfig.json uses those paths for the opencc vendor tree.
